title: Samsung's India chip research arm opens quantum lab at IISc
key_facts: Samsung Semiconductor India Research (SSIR) and IISc inaugurated a Quantum Research Lab in Bengaluru
Built with CSR support from SSIR
Work on qubit characterisation, cryogenic electronics, device reliability, single-photon sources and detectors
Open to researchers and students from other Indian institutions
Linked to India Semiconductor Workforce Development Program
Rajesh Krishnan, managing director of SSIR, and Prof. Govindan Rangarajan, IISc director, quoted
quote_evidence: Samsung Semiconductor India Research (SSIR) and the Indian Institute of Science (IISc.) inaugurated the Quantum Research Lab in the campus of the institute in Bengaluru.
A key objective of the Quantum Research Lab is to extend the benefits of this advanced infrastructure beyond IISc.
why_it_matters_hint: Industry-backed shared quantum lab for talent building in India.
